AGRICULTURE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #18
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Rearing Selected Animals? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Rearing Selected Animals.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Rearing Selected Animals.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Rearing Selected Animals.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Rearing Selected Animals.

2. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Primary consumers only
   B. Tertiary consumers
   C. Producers
   D. Decomposers only

3. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture of two liquids
   B. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   C. Any white crystal used in cooking
   D. Any substance that conducts electricity

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Inorganic fertilisers? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Inorganic fertilisers.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Inorganic fertilisers.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Inorganic fertilisers.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Inorganic fertilisers.

5. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Removing all vegetation
   B. Burning crop residue every week
   C. Overgrazing continuously
   D. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Aquaculture? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Aquaculture.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Aquaculture.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Aquaculture.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Aquaculture.

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Water conservation? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Water conservation.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Water conservation.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Water conservation.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Water conservation.

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Digestive systems of animals? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Digestive systems of animals.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Digestive systems of animals.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Digestive systems of animals.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Digestive systems of animals.

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Vegetative propagation? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Vegetative propagation.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Vegetative propagation.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Vegetative propagation.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Vegetative propagation.

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Livestock Products? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Livestock Products.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Livestock Products.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Livestock Products.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Livestock Products.

11. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. A chemical reaction forming ash
   B. Heating until a solid melts
   C. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   D. Movement of water only across a membrane

12. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. pascal (Pa)
   B. watt (W)
   C. joule (J)
   D. newton (N)

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Inorganic fertilisers and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Water conservation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Vegetative propagation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Agroforestry and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

5. D — Planting cover crops and terracing slopes

8. D — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Digestive systems of animals.

9. A — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Vegetative propagation.

10. A — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Livestock Products.
